column1: # NACA 23015 at the Reynolds numbers of Belloc's wind-tunnel model, solved with mfoil
# Source: computed by this tool - src/core/mfoil.js (the port of K. J. Fidkowski's mfoil, held to
#   mfoil.py to 3e-13 in data/reference/mfoil-sections.tsv) on naca5('23015', 120) from airfoil.js
#   'grid'    the slices' polar grid (slices.js: sliceSectionModel, 120 panels, the trailing edge
#             opened 1e-4; polarGridSteps from 3 degrees up and down, each solve from its
#             neighbour's boundary layer), at the Reynolds numbers reynoldsLevels spaces by a
#             factor of two over the model's chords at 40 m/s, 15% beyond: 0.107 to 0.350 m
#   'flight'  the flight model's section (brakesection.js: brakeSectionSteps, 160 panels, the
#             unbent section and bends of 10 and 20 degrees) at one Reynolds number, the mean
#             chord's (0.444 m2 over 1.705 m, 0.262 m) as the tool takes it for a flight
# measure: computed, by mfoil.js; converged solutions only (a missing angle did not converge)
# settings: ncrit 9; air 1.187 kg/m3 at 40 m/s, Re 0.92 million on the 0.350 m central chord
# bend_deg   the trailing edge's bend (flight); 0 for the grid
# cl cd cdf cm  lift, drag, friction drag, moment about the quarter chord
# xtr_upper xtr_lower  transition, fraction of chord
